name: SpotHero parking
description: SpotHero parking discovery and pricing for the US and Canada: hourly/daily, monthly and airport parking searches with itemised quotes for a time window, single-facility quotes, customer reviews, destinations with typical price ranges, upcoming events, and the city and airport directories. Read-only: no holds, bookings or checkout.

response.about: Search hourly/daily (transient) parking around a coordinate for an arrival/departure window (api.spothero.com/v2/search/transient, the request behind spothero.com/search). Each result is a facility with its address, distance from the origin, rating, live availability, access hours, restrictions, vehicle limits and one or more priced quotes for the window: `total_price` (what SpotHero charges, service fee included) and `advertised_price` (the headline rate without the fee), itemised. Event rates can widen the priced window; read each quote's `starts`/`ends`. Pass a SpotHero `destination_id` to anchor the search on a venue (its coordinates from `destination`) and to get `spot_url` links. Pages via `cursor`/`next_cursor`. Prices are USD in the US and CAD in Canada, taxes not itemised.
